meta.title: What's new in Stormlog
meta.description: Stormlog 0.4.2 can watch a vLLM server for sustained incidents and save bounded evidence around them without sending extra inference traffic.

updates.title: Watch a vLLM server for sustained incidents
updates.summary: The new infer watch command scrapes a vLLM server’s metrics and records an incident only after a trigger condition persists. It saves the surrounding evidence in a bounded bundle for later review.
highlights: Scrape /metrics beside the server without generating inference load
Preserve pre- and post-incident windows with trigger and collection-health records
Bound history, writer queues, and disk retention; publish complete bundle generations
Return exit code 3 when a counting incident is recorded
